description: SYMPTOM: the latency SLO is 500ms (p95) — the retry storm's 28s p95 is a breach an order of magnitude over budget, measured against a named objective
command: grep -A1 'alert:[[:space:]]*SLOLatencyBreach' observability/prometheus/rules/slo-orders.yml | grep -Eq '0\.5' && echo pass || echo fail

description: SYMPTOM: the UpstreamTimeoutSpike alert keys on orders_api_upstream_errors_total{type="timeout"} — the firing alert points at upstream timeouts, the storm's fingerprint
command: grep -A1 'alert:[[:space:]]*UpstreamTimeoutSpike' observability/prometheus/rules/alerts.yml | grep -Eq 'orders_api_upstream_errors_total\{type="timeout"\}' && echo pass || echo fail

description: FALSIFY RESOURCE HYPOTHESIS: the orders-api Helm values contain NO resources block — 'raise CPU/memory limits' targets a field that does not exist, so the resource hypothesis cannot be the fix
command: ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*resources:' platform/helm/orders-api/values.yaml && echo pass || echo fail

description: CAUSAL CHANGE: the retry-storm fixture is the change — RETRY_COUNT 3->10 and TIMEOUT_MS 5000->30000 — provable by diffing the fault fixture against the normal one
command: grep -Eq 'RETRY_COUNT=10' fixtures/fault-configs/retry-storm.env && grep -Eq 'RETRY_COUNT=3' fixtures/fault-configs/normal.env && echo pass || echo fail

description: MECHANISM: the client retries retry_count+1 attempts, each bounded by timeout_ms — 11 attempts x 30s is the amplifier that turns upstream latency into a self-inflicted storm, readable in source
command: grep -Eq 'range\(self\.settings\.retry_count \+ 1\)' app/orders-api/src/inventory_client.py && grep -q 'timeout=self.settings.timeout_ms' app/orders-api/src/inventory_client.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: MECHANISM: backoff grows as 2**attempt with no cap — with 10 retries the late attempts wait minutes, so a single request can occupy a worker far longer than the SLO, readable in source
command: grep -Fq '* (2 ** attempt)' app/orders-api/src/inventory_client.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: PARALLEL FALSIFICATION: three independent dimensions (retry / resource / recent-change) that reach retry-config from their OWN evidence corroborate; the resource dimension REFUTES its own hypothesis and does not distort the verdict
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["inventory_client.py:20"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"platform-resource","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"medium","sources":["no resources block in values.yaml"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"recent-change","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["retry-storm.env diff"],"derived_from":null}]' | bash scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'root_cause=retry-config' && echo pass || echo fail

description: DISCIPLINE: when the resource dimension is inconclusive (saturation not yet checked), synthesis withholds a verdict (need-more-evidence) instead of declaring a winner on partial data
command: printf '[{"dimension":"application-retry","root_cause":"retry-config","status":"supported","confidence":"high","sources":["inventory_client.py:20"],"derived_from":null},{"dimension":"platform-resource","root_cause":null,"status":"inconclusive","confidence":"low","sources":["kubectl top pending"],"derived_from":null,"missing":["node saturation"]}]' | bash scripts/synthesize-hypotheses.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'verdict=need-more-evidence' && echo pass || echo fail

description: CONTAINED REPAIR: the durable fix is a values change (lower RETRY_COUNT, add a timeout floor) in desired state — the env.RETRY_COUNT knob lives in Helm values, the field the GitOps proposal edits
command: grep -Eq 'RETRY_COUNT:' platform/helm/orders-api/values.yaml && echo pass || echo fail

description: GOVERNANCE: gitops-propose.sh is the change path and contains no cluster-write command — the incident fix is proposed in Git and synced by the reconciler, never applied by the investigator
command: [ -x scripts/gitops-propose.sh ] && ! grep -Eq '(kubectl[[:space:]]+(apply|delete|scale|patch|rollout)|helm[[:space:]]+(upgrade|install)|docker[[:space:]]+compose[[:space:]]+(up|restart))' scripts/gitops-propose.sh && echo pass || echo fail

description: SEPARATION OF DUTIES: the sre-investigator that diagnosed the storm has no write/apply authority — its authority-matrix row grants read + execute:[preflight,grade] only, so the diagnosis and the repair are different hands
command: grep -A6 '^  sre-investigator:' contracts/authority-matrix.yaml | grep -Eq 'write:[[:space:]]*\[\]' && echo pass || echo fail
